race.comment: MISCHIEVOUS MOLLY (14) doesn't win out of turn but finally draws a gate and boasts peaks that are good enough. Her record here is also good. Have to take seriously with Looker booked. STROBING (5) doesn't win out of turn but ran a strong race last time out over 1808m at this track, finishing a respectable fourth. Not a great deal tougher this time and he gets an important 2kg claim to aid the big weight. YORIKIRI (9) made considerable ground in the run home last start to finish second over the mile at Taree. Solid record at this track and trip. Set to run well. BONUS TEMPUS (3) has been less effective in his last two against better opposition but did catch the eye three back with a strong closing effort at Rosehill. Will drift back again from the draw but if the pace is genuine he can launch off their backs late.
